prompts.front:
Asset: Aurora granite colossus pixel-art walking animation, quality correction. The provided 210x210 original single sprite is the EXACT identity and rendering standard. Match its crisp individual PIXEL CLUSTERS, dark 1px outlines, angular granite slabs, olive moss crevices, sharply delineated cyan angular runes, bright blue diamond chest core, huge blocky shoulders and fists, small recessed helmet and stocky chunky separate legs. Same proportions and design as reference. Absolutely NO smooth painting, NO blurry details, NO airbrush, NO added spikes, NO redesigned face, NO rounded rubber limbs. Detailed hand-pixelled RPG sprite, original game's top-down camera. Draw at NATIVE pixel size about 210px tall per character, not a tiny sprite blown up. Each frame should look as sharp and intricate as the input image, with discrete flat-color clusters and hard angular edges.
Output ONE sprite atlas of EXACTLY SIX COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS (24 complete sprites), landscape aspect ratio 3:2, ideally 1536x1024 pixels, each square cell256x256, one sprite centered in each cell with feet baseline at y240. Entire body visible in every cell with clear transparent gutters. True TRANSPARENT background, no labels, no grid, no shadows, no environment. Same camera/scale/pivot across cells.
Each row is a looping SIX FRAME slow heavy walk in ONE fixed direction. Clearly ALTERNATE anatomical legs: column1 left foot forward contact/right back; col2 left supports while right heel rises; col3 right knee passing forward; col4 RIGHT foot forward contact/left back; col5 right supports while left heel rises; col6 left knee passing. Visible knee bending/feet lifting, slight torso bob and opposite arm swing. Frame4 must advance the opposite foot from frame1. Do not just repeat the idle or rotate/flip the entire body.
ROW ORDER, TOP TO BOTTOM: row1 DOWN (front facing viewer); row2 DOWN-RIGHT (front 3/4 facing lower right); row3 RIGHT (strict right profile); row4 UP-RIGHT (back 3/4 facing upper right, back plates visible). Four rows only, SIX frames per row. Preserve original crystalline stone edges and hard pixel contours. Transparency must be genuine alpha.
